title: Support & Incident Handling
subtitle: Tickets routed to your station based on assignments.
subtitleAdmin: All support tickets across the entire charging network.

kpi.inProgressHelpAdmin: Under investigation by staff or specialists
kpi.resolvingWatchHelpAdmin: Auto-closes per policy if no response received

workstream.platformHelp: Directly handled by Platform Admins for app errors, driver accounts, and platform-level wallet/deposit questions.
workstream.escalatedHelp: Admin reviews escalated support requests, returns them to the station or closes the support case with a documented reason.
workstream.stationHelp: Station Owners and Staff handle incidents directly. Refunds follow the Owner Finance Ledger.

escalation.bannerTitle: Support request sent to Admin for review
escalation.bannerClosedTitle: Escalation review concluded alongside ticket closure
escalation.cannotReviewClosed: Cannot review escalation on a resolved or closed ticket.

reasons.unresponsive24h: Station unresponsive for more than 24 hours

escalation.arbiterDisclaimer: Admin coordinates operational support; the review does not determine legal responsibility.

review.returnDescription: The review will end; station support can continue handling the ticket and record new technical findings.
review.closeDescription: Close the support process with a clear reason and review note.

modal.title: Request Admin Support Review
modal.roleNoticeDesc: Admin reviews the context, records a note, and either returns the case to station support or closes the support process with a documented reason.
modal.reasonHelp: Clearly describe points of disagreement and technical findings. Minimum 10 characters.
modal.reasonPlaceholder: e.g., Station checked hardware telemetry logs and verified normal connector operation. Both parties could not reach an agreement regarding reimbursement...

refundPolicy.cardSubtitle: Arbitration authority for escalated dispute cases
refundPolicy.infoNote: Admin reviews the application of ChargeOps 100% full package refund policy for this specific dispute case. Decisions take effect immediately on Simulator.

modal.title: Dispute Refund Policy Review
modal.mandateDesc: Admin adjudicates based on technical findings and telemetry. Decisions granting full package refund take effect immediately even if the Station Owner objects.
modal.reasonPlaceholder: Provide detailed grounds based on technical findings, communication log, and telemetry data...
modal.reasonRequired: Please provide adjudication justification (at least 5 characters).
modal.independenceNotice: Note: Refund policy adjudication does not substitute closing the support case (CLOSE_SUPPORT_CASE) or returning the case to station (RETURN_TO_STATION).
modal.successToast: Dispute refund policy decision issued successfully!
modal.versionConflict: Ticket or decision chain was updated by another process. Refreshing data...
modal.reasonTooLong: Justification reason must not exceed 2000 characters.
modal.affectedAtRequired: Please select the timestamp of station technical incident.
modal.futureAffectedAt: Incident timestamp cannot be in the future.
modal.genericError: An error occurred while issuing policy decision.
modal.grantDesc: Sufficient grounds of station failure. System automatically establishes a 100% package refund obligation ({{amount}}).
modal.insufficientDesc: Insufficient evidence of station failure. Decision recorded without generating a refund or revoking previous obligations.

ownerAdmission.title: Owner Admit Responsibility (BKG-056)
ownerAdmission.subtitle: Resolve dispute by committing to 100% full package refund
ownerAdmission.refundEstablishedDesc: System has recorded technical responsibility and automatically processed refund to driver. No further action needed.
ownerAdmission.notice: This ticket is under Admin dispute review. The Station Owner can proactively admit responsibility to establish a 100% refund for the driver without waiting for Admin arbitration.
ownerAdmission.notEligible: Booking is not eligible for station failure admission.

supervisory.bannerDesc: The Owner and Staff at {{station}} handle the incident. On escalation, Admin records an administrative review; refunds follow a separate flow.
supervisory.stationAssignedNotice: Station technician is actively investigating and resolving hardware issues on-site.
supervisory.stationUnassignedNotice: The Owner or Staff handles this ticket. Admin may route it to an active person at this station.

platformQueue.unassignedNotice: Platform incident awaiting assignment by an Admin specialist.

detail.claimSuccess: You have claimed this ticket successfully!
detail.resolveSuccess: Ticket marked as resolved and notification sent to driver!
detail.conflictWarning: Ticket data has been updated on the server. Reloading latest version...
detail.autoClosePolicyDisclaimer: Support Policy: An in-app notification has been sent to the driver. If no response is received within 10 days, this ticket will automatically close. Viewing notifications does not count as a response.
detail.closedBannerTitle: Ticket has been closed and completed
detail.closedHelp: Support workflow has ended. Any new issues arising after this must be submitted as a new ticket.
detail.noMessages: No messages in this thread yet.
detail.sendFirst: Send a message to start communicating with the reporter.
detail.composerClosedNotice: This ticket has been closed. No further replies can be sent.
detail.composerResolvedWarning: Waiting for the reporter to confirm or say the issue persists. Handlers cannot send messages at this stage.

handlerCard.title: Assigned Staff
handlerCard.unassignedDesc: This ticket is in the processing queue. Managers or station staff can claim directly or assign to a technician.

findings.title: Technical Findings
findings.empty: No technical findings recorded yet for this ticket.
findings.auditNote: Findings are audited and do not approve or execute a refund.
findings.closedDesc: Technical findings have been permanently archived in the audit log. Further updates are locked.
findings.escalatedLockedTitle: Admin is reviewing this support request
findings.escalatedLockedDesc: Station findings are paused during Admin review. Station support can continue after the case is returned.

refund.title: Deposit Refund Policy
refund.desc: Check each refund record for its current status. A ticket finding does not prove money was transferred.
refund.policyNotice: If a station failure is confirmed, Admin reviews the full package refund obligation. Recording a finding does not transfer money.

detail.composerPlaceholder: Type a response or resolution advice…

resolveModal.title: Confirm Incident Resolution
resolveModal.reasonHelp: Describe in detail the technical fix performed. This note will be dispatched directly to the driver.
resolveModal.reasonPlaceholder: E.g., Reconnected communication cable, restarted DC charger unit and verified charge cycle successfully...
resolveModal.disclaimer: * After submission, the driver has 10 days to reply or confirm. If the driver replies or indicates the issue persists, the ticket will automatically return to In Progress.

assignModal.selectStaffHelp: Only staff members actively assigned to this station are authorized to process this ticket.
assignModal.noActiveStaff: No active staff found for this station. Please assign staff to this station first.
assignModal.selectAdminHelp: Platform Administrators (Admin) are responsible for resolving platform and billing level incidents.
assignModal.noAdmins: No platform administrators found in the system.
assignModal.adminStationScopeDesc: Station charging incidents are handled directly by the Station Owner and technicians. Staff allocation is managed by the Station Owner. Admin oversees SLA and technical integrity.
assignModal.reasonHelp: Mandatory explanation for transferring this ticket (shift change, technical escalation, etc.). The previous staff member hands over handling responsibility.
assignModal.reasonPlaceholder: E.g., Afternoon shift change, handed over to platform specialist...

timeline.emptyHelp: Actions such as claiming, assigning, and resolving tickets will be permanently logged here.

errors.title: Error Notification
errors.accessDenied: You do not have access to view or perform actions on this support ticket.
errors.claimRequired: Claim this support ticket before sending a reply.
errors.notCurrentHandler: This support ticket is assigned to another handler; only the current handler can reply.
errors.notFound: The requested support ticket was not found or has been removed.
errors.invalidScope: The booking or station context is invalid for this support ticket.
errors.stateConflict: The support ticket cannot be modified in its current state.
errors.escalationNotActive: This ticket has no active escalation. Refresh the ticket to see its latest state.
errors.escalationReturnUnavailable: This ticket is resolved or closed. Admin can only complete its active escalation.
errors.escalationReviewInvalid: Provide a closure reason when closing the support case, and omit it when returning the case to the station.
errors.versionConflict: Ticket data has been updated by another user or session. Please refresh the page.
errors.closed: This support ticket is closed and cannot accept new replies.
errors.assignmentInvalid: The selected staff member cannot be assigned to this ticket.
errors.findingInvalid: The station-failure finding is invalid for this support ticket.
errors.codeConflict: The support ticket code already exists. Please try again.
errors.generic: An error occurred while processing your request. Please try again later.
errors.platformScopeOwnerWarning: This ticket pertains to Billing, User Accounts, or Platform Infrastructure managed directly by ChargeOps Platform Admins. Station Owners do not have authority over this ticket.
